title: The kit policy of a pyproject.toml
description: make layout-check (config/layout.kit.yml, lint-vulture-config) checks every pyproject.toml against it. vulture runs on each Python package with the confidence of kit (make lint-python), and a package keeps code that only its consumers use by an entry of its vulture_whitelist.py with the reason. [tool.vulture] may therefore only exclude generated code, each path with its reason in a comment.
